svg.title: How job-hunter works
svg.desc: A weekly loop of roles around a markdown workspace: Scout finds postings, Qualifier scores fit, Networker finds a referral, Writer builds the resume, you submit, Coach preps interviews, Operations reviews the week. An offer branches to Negotiator and Onboarder.
svg.text: One loop, nine roles, six commands. Everything is saved as markdown in your workspace.
Strategist, Networker, Onboarder: ask in plain English.
It drafts. You review and press submit.
Claims come from your profile; gaps are asked.
Public job boards only. No logins, no auto-apply.
